responses:
I checked each of the 4 findings against `tender.md`. **Two findings are wrong, and either one gets the offer rejected. Do not send it.** The analysis also leaves out 5 requirements, including the ones on efficiency class and hazardous-area certification.

## Findings

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | 14 AWG power cables "comply with 4.4" | tender.md §4.4: "minimum conductor cross-section of 2.5 mm²" | APPLIES | No override in §9 | **CONTRADICTED**: 14 AWG ≈ 2.08 mm², which is below the 2.5 mm² minimum. You need at least 12 AWG (≈ 3.31 mm²). |
| 2 | Motors rated for 122 °F ambient "comply with 9.2" | tender.md §9.2: "Ambient design temperature: 50 °C" | APPLIES | §9 takes precedence (§9.3) | **VERIFIED**: 122 °F = 50.0 °C exactly. This meets the requirement but leaves no margin. |
| 3 | 18 weeks delivery "complies" | tender.md §7.4: "within 16 weeks… Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected" | APPLIES | No §9 override | **CONTRADICTED**: 18 > 16 weeks, and the tender says such offers will be rejected. The finding also cites no clause. |
| 4 | 2-year warranty from commissioning "complies with 7.1" | tender.md §7.1: "24 months from the date of commissioning" | APPLIES | No §9 override | **VERIFIED**: 2 years = 24 months, starting from the same point (commissioning). |

**Counts:** VERIFIED 2 · CONTRADICTED 2 · UNSUPPORTED 0 · NEEDS HUMAN 0

## Requirements the analysis missed

1. **§9.1 overrides §4.2. P-01 (90 kW) must be IE4, not IE3.** §9.1 applies to motors above 75 kW, and §9.3 makes §9 take precedence over §4. This is the easiest one to get wrong.
2. **§4.2: P-02 (37 kW) must be IE3 minimum** under IEC 60034-30-1.
3. **§4.3 with Annex B: P-01 must be ATEX Ex d certified.** It is installed in the wet well, which Annex B classifies as Zone 1. P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so this doesn't apply to P-02.
4. **§4.1:** all equipment must suit a 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply.
5. **§4.5:** panel and motor terminal enclosures must be IP65 or better.

The offer doesn't say anything about items 1–5, so I can't tell whether it complies with them. Each one needs to be checked against the actual offered equipment.

I found no text in either document addressed to reviewers or AI tools, so there are no tampering flags.

## Go / no-go

**NO-GO.** Before sending:
- Fix the delivery time to 16 weeks or less (§7.4 says it's grounds for rejection).
- Upsize the cables to 2.5 mm² minimum (§4.4).
- Confirm and state compliance for the 5 missed requirements, especially IE4 and ATEX Ex d for P-01.
